summary.text: Tom Kuhn is a Republican member of the Michigan House of Representatives representing District 57 and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Tom Kuhn's general-election opponent is Tom Turner (D).
He is a lawyer who previously served on the Royal Oak City Commission and the Oakland Community College Board of Trustees.

paragraphs.text: Thomas Kuhn lives in Troy, Michigan, and earned a bachelor's degree in political science from the University of Michigan, a master's degree and doctorate in political science from the University of Toronto, and a law degree from the Detroit College of Law (now the Michigan State University College of Law).
His career experience includes working as a lawyer.
Kuhn served on the Royal Oak City Commission and the Oakland Community College Board of Trustees.
Kuhn assumed office in the Michigan House on January 1, 2023, and has been assigned to the House Appropriations Committee in both the 2023-2024 and 2025-2026 terms.
